title: Derivation of a new drive/coast motor driver model for real-time brushed DC motor control, and validation on a MIP robot
authors: Eric N. Sihite; Daniel J. Yang; Thomas R. Bewley
locator: Sections V-A/V-B and VI, Fig. 3 and Tables IV–V
finding: An optical encoder, known flywheel inertia and separate INA219 current sensor support comparison of driver models over three motors. The authors report mean prediction RMSE of 6.5% of stall current for their drive/coast model and 22.5% for the tested linear baseline. The dynamometer excitation was open-loop; section VI tests closed-loop balancing.

title: Load-Side Dynamics Introduces Complex Effects on Orthotic Actuator Performance in Benchmarking
authors: Mingrui Sun; Denny Oetomo; Ying Tan; Dana Kulić; Tomislav Baček
locator: JMR volume 17 (May 2025), 051012. Sections 4.1.3, 4.2.1 and 4.3.2; Figures 3 and 6; Data Availability Statement
finding: An inline FUTEK TRS600-50Nm measures interaction torque separately from spring deflection inferred using encoders. The control diagram includes velocity saturation. Bandwidth tests use 8 and 16 Nm reference chirps over 0.1–50 Hz in 30 s. The authors locate all study data in the paper; machine-readable saturation labels were not found. The paper prints 2025 as online and issue year; Crossref online year differs.
